name: Eastside Rollin' 80s Skyline Pirus
description: Eastside Rollin' 80s Skyline Pirus is a Blood-affiliated street gang based on the Eastside of Detroit, Michigan. Operating under California Piru naming conventions, they are documented rivals of the 7 Mile Rollin' 60s Crips and the 6 Mile Bounty Hunna Watts Bloods (6M BHB).

sources.title: Inside the Powerful Rise of 7 Mile Rollin' 60s Crips in Detroit – DetroitStreetGangs.com
